why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Use only official links: de1.ai , docs.de1.ai, app.de1.exchange, platform.de1.ai, x.com/De1_ai and t.me/de1official. Old OpenOcean links and lookalike accounts are around, so check the address before you connect anything.
Join the Ginza 1.0 waitlist at platform.de1.ai/waitlist with an email. The page says "Currently free".

If you already swap, route a real trade through app.de1.exchange with your own wallet. Per the docs, your first eligible trade opens a Signal Passport. Warning Only trade what you would trade anyway. Signal Value has no stated worth, and De1 warns: "Readings can be revised. Traces can be zeroed."
Don't wash trade or split activity across wallets. The docs score both down, and the terms allow one account per person.
Follow De1 on X and Telegram for the participation details it said it would "shortly announce".
costs: The waitlist is free. The Passport is not: it only grows with real trades, so you pay swap costs, gas and the market risk of whatever you buy. We could not read De¹ Exchange's fee schedule, because its FAQ answers only load in the app. Gas is not refundable. The terms say "under no circumstances will a transaction through the Services be invalidated, revocable, retractable, or otherwise refundable
risks: Excluded countries, as the terms write them: "the United States, North Korea, Syria, Iran, Cuba, Venezuela, Crimea, Luhansk, Donetsk and any other country that has been identified as being sanctioned by the United States of America, United Kingdom, European Union or United Nations".
